args.prompt:
One continuous 30-second take: a single unbroken camera move, no cuts, no jump cuts, no scene changes, no time skips. Smooth gimbal, no shake. 35mm film look, soft natural grain, shallow depth of field.
CAST: @Image1 shows the exact product: a heavy rectangular perfume bottle of thick clear glass filled with amber-gold perfume, a faceted smoky dark-amber glass cap, the word VESPER engraved on the front. It is the only product and the only readable text. It never moves, changes shape or changes size; the engraved VESPER stays sharp and unchanged.
FIRST FRAME: the bottle stands on a polished dark marble ledge high above a city skyline; the sun sits low on the horizon directly behind it, flooding the glass with orange light.
RULES: real physics; one camera path; the sky changes continuously like a slow time-lapse from sunset to blue hour to night, never a cut.
[0-7 s] The camera is already moving: a slow, constant push toward the bottle; the sun glows through the perfume like a lantern.
[7-15 s] Without cutting, the camera begins a slow arc around the bottle at constant radius; the sun slides down below the skyline; warm light inside the glass fades to deep amber.
[15-23 s] The sky deepens to blue hour; city windows switch on one by one and reflect in the marble; the glass catches the first city lights.
[23-30 s] Night: the camera completes its arc and settles exactly on the final composition, the bottle centred against a glittering night city, amber perfume glowing warmly.
AUDIO: none.
No people, no hands, no text overlays, no extra bottles, no logos besides VESPER.
